Everything you need to know about the airports closest to Washington, DC including transportation information, airport maps and much more.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are three major airports in the Washington, DC region: [Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport](http://www.flyreagan.com/dca/reagan-national-airport) (DCA), [Washington Dulles International Airport](http://www.flydulles.com/iad/dulles-international-airport) (IAD) and [Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport](https://www.bwiairport.com/) (BWI).

If you're looking for general information about how to get to all three DC-area airports, below are some [transportation options](https://washington.org/find-dc-listings/airports-and-airport-transportation) for your trip. You can also book a greeter through [Air General Traveler Services](https://airgeneraltraveler.com/), which can provide interline transfer connections, baggage and porter services, arrangements for airline lounge access, arrangements for hotel business centers and airport shopping assistance. For those with accessibility needs, call [TSA Cares](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/tsa-cares) at 1-855-787-2227 at least 72 hours prior to traveling with any questions about screening policies, procedures and what to expect at the security checkpoint.

**Which airport are you looking to learn more about?**

*   [**Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA)**](https://washington.org/DC-guide-to/washington-dc-airports#RonaldReaganWashingtonNationalAirport)
*   [**Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)**](https://washington.org/DC-guide-to/washington-dc-airports#WashingtonDullesInternationalAirport)
*   [**Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI)**](https://washington.org/DC-guide-to/washington-dc-airports#BWIThurgoodMarshallAirport)

![Image 21: A bustling airport terminal features arched ceilings, travelers walking with luggage, and a food court including Ben's Chili Bowl.](https://washington.org/sites/default/files/2025-03/docrox6%20Instagram%201744-ig-1691623458315148008_528613988.jpg)

### **Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport**

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is located just across the Potomac River in Virginia and is the closest airport to DC. (It’s also the airport you’re most likely to spot senators and representatives heading home to their districts.) Reagan Airport offers nonstop flights to 100-plus destinations on eight airlines.

### How do I get to/from Reagan Airport?

The airport is accessible via its own Metro stop on the Blue and Yellow lines. To catch a taxi, look for the official stand outside of baggage claim for a $15-20 ride into downtown DC. Rideshare apps like Uber and Lyft are also good options to get to and from the airport.

Driving is also a possibility, as the airport has multiple garages and parking lots. For more information, check out the [Reagan Airport transportation and parking page](http://www.flyreagan.com/dca/parking-transportation).

### Reagan Airport map and flight information

You can find everything you need at Reagan Airport with the [terminal map](http://www.flyreagan.com/dca/terminal-map). With so many flights each day, make sure to use the airport’s [flight guide](http://www.flyreagan.com/dca/flight-guide) to find the best options to and from the District.

### Where can I eat and shop at Reagan Airport?

Arrive early or have a layover? Rest assured, there are plenty of [dining and shopping](http://www.flyreagan.com/dca/food-shops) options at Reagan Airport. Local favorites include CAVA for fast-casual Mediterranean bowls bursting with flavor and the legendary Ben's Chili Bowl.

### Accessibility

The Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority is fully committed to providing universal access to all public facilities and services at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport for all its patrons. For detailed information regarding ground transportation, the Sunflower lanyard program, pet relief areas, wheelchair rentals, public restroom access, security checkpoint access and additional amenities, visit the airport's [website](https://www.flyreagan.com/customer-service/services-patrons-disabilities).

### **Washington Dulles International Airport**

Washington Dulles International Airport is located 26 miles from DC in suburban Virginia. Dulles Airport is also the primary international airport for the DC region, with almost 157 nonstop domestic and international destinations on nearly 40 airlines. Dulles is a major hub for [United Airlines](https://washington.org/united-airlines-washington-dc).

### How do I get to/from Dulles Airport?

Connected to DC on Metro's Silver line, each ride to Dulles takes about an hour from downtown DC. Washington Flyer taxi cabs exclusively service Dulles Airport and taxi stands are located outside the main terminal; a taxi or rideshare into the city will cost roughly $60-$70.

For more information on parking and car rentals, visit the [Dulles Airport transportation and parking page](http://www.flydulles.com/iad/parking-transportation).

### Dulles Airport map and flight information

The busy international airport has a number of terminals and gates. Make sure you view the [airport and terminal map](http://www.flydulles.com/iad/airport-and-terminal-maps) for the most up-to-date information. The [Dulles Airport flight guide](http://www.flydulles.com/iad/flight-guide) will also help with upcoming scheduled flights, as well as arrival and departure information.

### Where can I eat and shop at Dulles Airport?

With everything from duty-free souvenirs to high-end designers and even a spa, you can satisfy all your [dining and shopping](http://www.flydulles.com/iad/shopping-dining-directory) needs at Dulles Airport. Look for Chef Geoff’s, a local favorite, or stop by &pizza for build-your-own personal pies.

### Accessibility

The Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority is fully committed to providing universal access to all public facilities and services at Washington Dulles International Airport for all of its patrons. For detailed information regarding ground transportation, the Sunflower lanyard program, public parking, pet relief areas, wheelchair rentals, public restroom access, security checkpoint access and additional amenities, visit the airport's [website](https://www.flydulles.com/customer-service/disability-services).

### **Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport**

Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI) is a bit further from DC near Baltimore, Md., but oftentimes that means you can find even better flight deals. The airport has grown to 90-plus domestic and international destinations and services more than 27.1 million passengers each year.

### How do I get to/from Baltimore/Washington International Airport?

BWI is located 32 miles from DC and is easily accessible via MARC and Amtrak train routes that connect to Union Station. A dedicated shuttle service provides transportation between the train station and the airport terminal. Taxis, Uber and Lyft are also available at the airport. Make sure to visit the [BWI Airport transportation page](https://www.bwiairport.com/to-from-bwi) for information about parking, car rentals and more.

### Baltimore/Washington Airport map and flight information

[BWI Airport's interactive map](https://www.bwiairport.com/wayfinding) can help you find your way around the terminals, while the airport’s [flight guide](https://www.bwiairport.com/flying-with-us/flights) is a great resource for finding scheduled flights as well as arrival and departure information.

### Where can I eat and shop at Baltimore/Washington Airport?

There are great [places to eat and shop](https://www.bwiairport.com/at-bwi/things-to-do) for travelers, as well as a fitness center if you’re looking to get in a quick workout before your flight.

### Accessibility

For detailed information regarding wheelchair service, TSA passenger support specialists, lift-equipped buses, animal relief areas, public restroom access and services for the visually impaired and hard-of-hearing, visit BWI's [website](https://bwiairport.com/flying-with-us/accessibility/).
